verdict.rationale: Sierra's Insights product explicitly tracks 'case resolution' as a critical metric alongside CSAT (sierra-docs-22), indicating the platform is built to measure true resolution outcomes rather than just deflection, and τ-bench (sierra-docs-27) frames evaluation around task completion. However, there are no published resolution-rate figures, customer case studies, or independent audits quantifying how much of conversation volume is fully resolved end-to-end.  missing for 10: quantified resolution-rate statistics or case studies, independent/third-party verification of resolution vs deflection, clear definition distinguishing resolution from deflection in reporting.
